checks.findings: Southern Morocco ethnobotanical study, 560 participants. Survey describes use, not intervention efficacy or pregnancy safety. Ethics dossier 29/19. Compare TH2-006 for setting but no overlap established.

checks.findings: Qualitative study of Maasai women and other stakeholders in Ngorongoro, Tanzania, concerning facility-assisted delivery. Child Health Foundation funded study, approved design/instruments and reviewed/approved final report for publication; not directly involved in data collection, analysis or interpretation. EbOO project funded by Mennonite Central Committee via Luann Martin Legacy Fund; MCC leadership approved publication; first author employed by MCC. Explicit sponsor involvement and potential institutional allegiance recorded, not evidence of misconduct. Care access and acceptability not intervention effects.

Unsafe practices retained as counseling context, not instructions.
